<!-- pr-reviewer: 7a803d0f1901dbb2fc5f1f5965e6bb04b1c826c0 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** It's stacked on #810 (on #798), so it merges after them, at the cut. I reviewed only this PR's own commit, `7a803d0f`, on top of #810's head `31acc320`, which is unchanged. The trial merge with current `main` was clean.

### What looks good
- **Axis rule** (`crates/app/src/posting_index_swing.rs:59-69`, `rotary_line`):
  - A stated vector decides the line.
  - With no vector, the RS-274 letter decides it: `A` is about X and is judged; `B` and `C` are off X; any other name is `Unknown` and refuses by name.
  - `work_a` puts an `Unknown` refusal ahead of a judged A, so a machine holding both refuses. That closes #813 item 1.
- **`turns_part: Option<bool>`** (`crates/post/src/machine/def.rs:68-69`, `parse.rs:316`):
  - A parsed rotary always gets `Some(..)` and a linear axis gets `None`.
  - `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]` loads old files as `None`, and a fresh save writes `true` or `false`. The load test checks that a fresh save contains `"turns_part": true`.
  - An older build reading the new key still sees a plain bool, so the format stays additive and needs no `PROJECT_VERSION` step.
- **Every reader handles `None` safely.** There are two readers in the tree:
  - The clause (`posting_index_swing.rs:85`) judges only `Some(true)`.
  - The note (`swing_note.rs:32`) names only `is_none()`.
  - All other uses are `..Default::default()` constructions in tests and in the machine editor's "add axis", which makes a linear axis. The UI crate builds against the change (`cargo check -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` is clean).
- **Load note** (`crates/app/src/project/swing_note.rs`, wired at `apply.rs:568`):
  - It covers the document's machine and each setup's own machine.
  - It names the machine model and the rotary, and leaves out `B`, `C` and stated off-X rotaries.
  - It reaches the GUI status line through `load_noted` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:3849`) and the log through `open_noted`.
  - The false note on a pre-#804 tilt-head is stated in the decision record and the PR body, and a reload clears it. I agree that it's acceptable: a spurious "reload" note is the safe side.
- **#810's body** now carries the "Changelog note (#813)" paragraph about custom table-A machines without `nose_to_axis`. This PR's own `Changelog:` line has the wording.
- **Law check:**
  - No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests.
  - The new module carries a provenance line, and the decision record is in `docs/decisions/813-swing-gaps.md`.
  - No process files, `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts, dependencies, `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot PNGs or `tests/golden/` changes.
  - Conventional subject, a `Changelog:` line, and the body ends `Fixes #813`.

### Local results (merged with main, macOS, private target)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| index_swing | 9 passed |
| tormach_fourth_axis | 12 passed |
| microarc_test_part | 2 passed |
| machine | 33 passed |
| machine_library | 11 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 71 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| tilt | 8 passed |
| rotary_letter | 3 passed |
| rotary_verify | 9 passed |
| camcraft-post (all) | lib 9, axis_direction_cli 3, comp 9, comp_plane 3, mch_head_search 2, post_engine 33, all passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo check -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` | clean |

**Revert checks.** I ran each of these separately, and each one fails only its own pin:
- `"A" => RotaryLine::OffX`: fails `a_custom_table_a_with_no_axis_vector_is_judged_about_x`.
- `_ => RotaryLine::OffX` (no `Unknown`): fails `a_work_turning_rotary_with_no_line_and_no_rs274_letter_is_refused_by_name`.
- The `notes.extend(swing_note::notes)` line commented out: fails `a_project_saved_before_804_names_its_unjudged_table_a_on_load`.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. **A work-turning B about Y is not judged at all.** I suggest a follow-up issue rather than a change here.
   - **The gap:** a user's own `.mch` with a table B (vector `[0,1,0]`, or none and named `B`) that turns the work reads `OffX`, so it gets no swing check, no refusal and no load note. The geometry is the same as A about X with Y in place of X: a vertical tool tip at height h is at least h from any horizontal line through WCS X0 Z0, so the same tip-versus-swept-radius test applies. The pose law posts B, so a `G0 B..` index can swing the work into a retracted tool unjudged. This is the class of silent pass #813 closed for A.
   - **Why a follow-up:** #804 and #813 are scoped to an A about X (the microARC). No shipped machine has a work-turning B (`millturn.mch`'s C carries the head), and nothing judged any swing before #804, so this is no regression.
   - **C about Z is safe for this check:** turning about a vertical line keeps every point's height, so a tool above the stock top stays clear.
   - **Suggested issue:** "index swing: judge a work-turning rotary about Y (table B)", P1, effort:high, area:multiaxis. Generalise `rotary_line` and the swept radius to the rotary's horizontal line, and refuse when `nose_to_axis` is unstated, as for A.
   - The same applies to a rotary named `A` whose stated vector is off X.
2. **The load note is load-time only.** A pre-#804 table A stays unjudged at post time. `open_project` (MCP) and `cam.load` (script) call `project::load`, which drops the notes to the log (`crates/app/src/script/api.rs:24`). So a headless agent posting such a project gets no sign that the swing went unjudged. This is pre-existing for every #342 note.
   - A cheap follow-up would be one non-refusing line in the verification report for a `turns_part: None` rotary on or possibly on X. That would reach MCP's `verify` and the post path.
   - The decision record's reason for not refusing (a pre-#804 tilt-head) still holds for a warning.
3. **No vector, mislabelled letter:** a rotary named `B` or `C` that really turns about X reads off X and is not judged. That's the user's file contradicting the standard; noted for completeness.
4. **File size:** `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs` is 822 lines and grows by 3. It's on the 400-line watch list.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
